svg.title: Architecture comparison of Prescribed Local SOT, M1 one-way drift-diffusion, and M2 reciprocal Onsager transport
svg.desc: Three-column scientific architecture comparing (a) local algebraic PrescribedSpinOrbitTorque without transport PDEs, (b) one-way CurrentTransport to SpinDriftDiffusion to DriftDiffusionSpinTorque (M1), and (c) bidirectional coupled charge-spin Onsager block (M2), with an additive RHS guard.
